title: Beach Attitudes on 30A
meta_description: Experience the ultimate 30A getaway at Beach Attitudes on 30A, a gorgeous new luxury vacation home in Santa Rosa Beach with a large private pool, hot tub, street-legal golf cart and an easy walk to the beach. Professionally decorated and designed for families and groups, this spacious 6-bedroom retreat features five ensuite bedrooms, a custom bunk room with two full-over-full
description_expanded: AboutBeach Attitudes on 30A | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental with Private Pool, Hot Tub and Golf Cart | Walk to Beach Welcome to Beach Attitudes on 30A, a gorgeous new luxury vacation home in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, professionally decorated and thoughtfully designed for unforgettable family vacations, multi-family getaways and group trips along Scenic Highway 30A. This exceptional 30A vacation rental combines beautiful coastal interiors with incredible amenities, including a large private pool, hot tub, backyard oasis, street-legal golf cart, six bicycles, multiple balconies, six bedrooms, five ensuite bathrooms, custom full-over-full bunk beds, three separate living and sitting spaces, two kitchenettes, two refrigerators, two dishwashers, two ovens, and two full-size washer and dryer sets. Best of all, you can walk to the beach and enjoy an outstanding location close to some of the best dining, shopping and entertainment along 30A. Whether your perfect vacation means mornings at the beach, afternoons beside your private pool, cruising 30A in the golf cart, biking along the coast, gathering for dinner with family and friends, or relaxing in the hot tub after sunset, Beach Attitudes on 30A was designed to make vacationing together easy. Home Highlights • Gorgeous new-build luxury home on Scenic Highway 30A • Walk to the beach • Large private swimming pool • Private hot tub • Beautiful backyard oasis • Street-legal golf cart included • Six bicycles included • Six bedrooms with flexible accommodations for families and groups • Five bedrooms feature private ensuite bathrooms • Three additional half bathrooms • Four king bedrooms • Custom bunk room with two sets of full-over-full built-in bunk beds • Sixth bedroom with queen hideaway bed and kitchenette can also serve as a third sitting room • Three separate living and sitting areas • Second living room on the third floor with foosball table and kitchenette • Professionally decorated luxury coastal interiors • Fully stocked gourmet kitchen • Two full-size refrigerators • Two dishwashers • Two ovens • Generous indoor dining and living room seating • Two kitchenettes for added convenience • Two sets of full-size washers and dryers • Multiple balconies for enjoying the coastal atmosphere • Spacious outdoor dining area • Plenty of outdoor lounge seating • Poolside seating and lounging areas • Outdoor TVs • Cornhole • Backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella • Parking for 6 cars • Near Eastern Lake and Old Florida Fish House • Close to Seaside, Seagrove Beach and popular 30A dining, shopping and entertainment • Ideal for family vacations, multi-generational trips and groups traveling together A Gorgeous Luxury Vacation Home on 30A From the moment you arrive at Beach Attitudes on 30A, you'll see that this is not an ordinary beach house. This beautiful new-build Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental has been professionally decorated with an upscale coastal style that feels luxurious while remaining comfortable and inviting. Thoughtful furnishings, beautiful finishes and generous gathering spaces make the home ideal for guests who want the amenities of a luxury 30A vacation rental with plenty of room for everyone to enjoy time together. The spacious layout is especially well suited for multiple families and multi-generational groups. Adults can gather in the main living room while children and teenagers enjoy the third-floor living area, or guests can retreat to the additional sitting room when they want a quieter place to relax. With multiple living spaces, numerous bathrooms, two laundry areas and multiple kitchen and beverage-preparation areas, Beach Attitudes makes sharing a large vacation home surprisingly easy. Fully Stocked Kitchen Designed for Large Groups The heart of Beach Attitudes on 30A is its beautiful, fully stocked kitchen and spacious main living area. Designed with family gatherings and group vacations in mind, the kitchen provides plenty of room for preparing everything from a quick beach-day breakfast to a memorable family dinner. One of the home's biggest advantages for large groups is the addition of two full-size refrigerators, two ovens, and two dishwashers. There is plenty of refrigerator space for groceries, beverages and vacation favorites, plus two ovens and two dishwashers, preparing and cleaning up after large family meals is effortless. The kitchen flows into the dining and living spaces, where generous seating makes it easy for everyone to gather together. Whether you're preparing fresh Gulf seafood, ordering dinner from a favorite 30A restaurant or simply enjoying coffee before heading to the beach, the home's open layout creates a comfortable gathering place for your entire group. Three Living and Sitting Spaces One of the features families will appreciate most about Beach Attitudes is the abundance of separate gathering spaces. The beautiful main living room provides plenty of comfortable seating for relaxing, watching television or spending time together. On the third floor, guests will discover a second living room complete with a foosball table and kitchenette. It's an ideal hangout for kids and teenagers, a game-night destination or simply another comfortable space for guests to spread out. The home's sixth bedroom provides even more flexibility. Featuring a queen hideaway bed and kitchenette, this room can function as a private sleeping space when needed or be enjoyed as a third sitting room during the day. For large families and groups, having multiple places to gather, play and relax can make an enormous difference, especially during longer 30A vacations. Five bedrooms feature private ensuite bathrooms, giving adult guests the convenience of having their own private bathroom rather than sharing with the entire group. The custom bunk room is a standout feature for families, offering two sets of built-in full-over-full bunk beds. The full-size mattresses provide considerably more sleeping space than traditional twin bunks and create a fun retreat for children, teenagers or additional guests. The sixth bedroom offers a queen hideaway bed and kitchenette and can be configured as either additional sleeping accommodations or another sitting and gathering space. In addition to the five ensuite bathrooms, the home provides three additional half bathrooms, making Beach Attitudes exceptionally convenient when a large group is staying together. Two Full-Size Laundry Areas Beach vacations generate plenty of towels and laundry, so Beach Attitudes includes two separate sets of full-size washers and dryers. For families sharing the home or guests enjoying an extended stay on 30A, having two laundry areas makes it easy to keep beach towels, swimsuits and clothing ready for another day along the Gulf. Your Private 30A Backyard Oasis The backyard may quickly become your favorite part of Beach Attitudes. Step outside into a private outdoor retreat centered around a large private swimming pool and hot tub, creating your own resort-style experience without ever leaving the house. Spend sunny Florida afternoons floating in the pool, stretch out with a book beside the water, or relax in the hot tub after a day exploring 30A. The outdoor space offers plenty of seating for dining, lounging and relaxing poolside, allowing everyone to enjoy the backyard together without feeling crowded. Gather for an outdoor meal, watch television outside, challenge the family to a game of cornhole, or simply settle into a comfortable chair and enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of a Florida beach vacation. With outdoor TVs, dining space, lounge seating, poolside seating, cornhole, a large private pool and hot tub, the backyard isn't simply an amenity—it's another complete living and entertainment space. Walk to the Beach Of course, no 30A vacation is complete without time along the Gulf of Mexico. From Beach Attitudes on 30A, guests can walk to the beach and experience the sugar-white sand and beautiful emerald-green waters that make South Walton and Florida's Emerald Coast famous. Pack the provided backpack beach chairs and beach umbrella, head toward the Gulf, and spend the day swimming, relaxing and making memories along one of Florida's most beautiful stretches of coastline. After the beach, return home for a refreshing swim in your private pool or unwind in the hot tub. Street-Legal Golf Cart Included Exploring the area is even more fun with the home's street-legal golf cart. Cruise to nearby dining, shopping and entertainment, explore the surrounding 30A area, or use the golf cart to make getting around during your vacation even more convenient. A golf cart is one of the most sought-after amenities for a 30A vacation, and having one included with Beach Attitudes gives your group another way to experience the laid-back coastal lifestyle. Guests are responsible for following all applicable laws, community requirements and golf cart rules during their stay. Six Bicycles Included Scenic Highway 30A is made for exploring by bicycle, and Beach Attitudes provides six bicycles for guests to enjoy. Take a morning ride, explore nearby Seagrove Beach, stop for coffee, head out for lunch, or simply enjoy an evening bike ride as the Florida sun begins to set. With a street-legal golf cart and six bicycles available at the home, it's easy to get out and experience the restaurants, shops and coastal communities that make 30A such a special vacation destination. Multiple Balconies and Outdoor Living Spaces Beach Attitudes offers several balconies, giving guests even more places to step outside and enjoy the coastal atmosphere. Start your morning outdoors with a cup of coffee, find a quiet spot to read during the afternoon, or enjoy an evening drink after a full day at the beach. Combined with the home's backyard oasis and generous poolside living spaces, the balconies give guests multiple opportunities to enjoy indoor-outdoor living throughout their stay. Incredible Location Near Eastern Lake and Old Florida Fish House Beach Attitudes puts you in a fantastic location for experiencing the best of Scenic Highway 30A. The home is near Eastern Lake, one of South Walton's rare coastal dune lakes, and close to Old Florida Fish House, a longtime 30A favorite known for waterfront dining, seafood, sushi, live entertainment and its beautiful Eastern Lake setting. This area offers a wonderful combination of beach access and convenience while keeping guests close to the dining, shopping, entertainment and outdoor recreation that make 30A one of Florida's most popular beach destinations. Close to Seaside and the Best of 30A When you're ready to explore, Beach Attitudes provides a convenient home base for discovering the famous beach communities along Scenic Highway 30A. Spend time exploring Seagrove Beach and Seaside, discover local restaurants and coffee shops, browse boutiques, enjoy live entertainment, bike along 30A or simply cruise the area and see where the day takes you. Nearby activities and attractions include: • Beautiful Gulf of Mexico beaches • Seaside • Seagrove Beach • Eastern Lake • Old Florida Fish House • Local seafood restaurants • Coffee shops and cafés • Boutique shopping • Live music and entertainment • Scenic biking and walking • Paddleboarding and kayaking • Fishing • Gulf activities • South Walton's rare coastal dune lakes • Scenic Highway 30A communities and attractions Whether your group wants to spend every day at the beach or explore a different part of 30A each morning, Beach Attitudes makes it easy to experience the area. Perfect for Families and Multi-Generational 30A Vacations Beach Attitudes is especially well suited for large families, multiple families traveling together and multi-generational vacations. Five ensuite bedrooms provide privacy for adults, while the custom full-over-full bunk room creates a fun sleeping space for younger guests. Three separate living and sitting spaces give everyone room to spread out, while the large kitchen, dining area, private pool and outdoor living spaces bring the entire group back together. Add two refrigerators, two ovens, two dishwashers, two sets of washers and dryers, multiple kitchenettes and numerous bathrooms, and you have a home designed to make a large-group beach vacation more comfortable from beginning to end. Everything You Want in a Luxury 30A Vacation Rental Beach Attitudes on 30A brings together the features travelers look for when searching for an exceptional 30A vacation rental in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida: a gorgeous new luxury home, professionally designed interiors, walkability to the beach, a large private pool, hot tub, street-legal golf cart, six bicycles, multiple living spaces, ensuite bedrooms, custom bunk accommodations and an incredible location close to dining, shopping and entertainment. Spend the morning at the beach. Cruise 30A in the golf cart. Bike to a nearby restaurant. Come home for an afternoon beside your private pool. Gather around the table for dinner. Challenge the kids to foosball or cornhole. Then end the evening relaxing in the hot tub. Whether you're planning a family beach vacation, multi-generational getaway, reunion with friends or memorable group trip to Florida's Emerald Coast, Beach Attitudes on 30A offers the space, amenities, location and luxury to make your time together unforgettable. Come for the beach. Stay for the pool. Leave with a whole new Beach Attitude. Book your stay at Beach Attitudes on 30A and experience luxury vacation living in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Pack less. Vacation more.
